'''Chocovine Town''' (Japanese: '''アケビタウン''' ''Akebi Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Sinnoh]]. It is a bustling port town located southeast of [[Snowpoint City]], as shown in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]''. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it has a [[Contest Hall]]. According to [[Marian]], Chocovine Town is known as "the town of great people coming and going".

Besides being a popular spot for [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s who wish to enter the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]], Chocovine Town is a well-known tourist destination thanks to the seasonal migration of {{p|Phione}}. The town is one of the few places where the rare {{pkmn|category|Sea Drifter Pokémon}} can be seen, and once a year the town swarms with sightseers. The local water park is also a tourist attraction.

Chocovine Town was first mentioned in ''[[DP106|A Breed Stampede!]]'', when Marian announced on [[television]] that the town would host the next [[Pokémon Contest]]. In ''[[DP109|Leading a Stray!]]'', {{Ash}} and {{Ashfr}} attempted to leave [[Canalave City]] for Chocovine Town, but the ferry was cancelled due to a group of {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Wailord}} blocking the harbor. The town first appeared at the end of ''[[DP112|Cheers on Castaways Isle!]]'', when Ash, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}} were taken there by boat by [[Officer Jenny]].

==Places of interest==
[[File:Phione merchandise DP113.png|thumb|220px|Phione-themed goods]]
===Phione watching===
In ''[[DP113|Hold the Phione!]]'', it was revealed that many {{p|Phione}} migrate to the town every year. As a result, Phione-themed merchandise, such as {{pkmn|doll}}s, T-shirts, and candies, are sold in the town yearly in relation to this event. In addition, tourists are able to take a ride on a [[Transportation in the Pokémon world|submarine]] to hopefully see the {{pkmn2|Mythical}} Phione up close.

A local Phione-themed merchant claimed there was an old legend in Chocovine Town that says "good luck smiles down on those who spot the Phione", and that all past winners of the Chocovine {{pkmn|Contest}} were {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s who had spotted the {{pkmn|category|Sea Drifter Pokémon}} before their competitions (though either of these statements may have been deliberately spurious to drive sales). After hearing that, {{an|Dawn}} decided to go see the Phione.

At night, Dawn and her friends boarded a submarine crewed by a [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|disguised]] {{TRT}}. [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} were initially worried Phione would fail to show up and they would have to return the money they got from selling tickets for the Phione-watching tour. However, that was not necessary as three {{pkmn2|wild}} Phione appeared and were sighted by their customers.

===Pokémon Center===
{{main|Pokémon Center}}
The Chocovine Town Pokémon Center first appeared in ''[[DP113|Hold the Phione!]]''. It was where {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} stayed during their time in Chocovine Town. In ''[[DP114|Another One Gabites the Dust!]]'', {{an|Dawn}} was shown in front of the Pokémon Center doing some last-minute preparations for the [[Pokémon Contest]] to be held that day. She was going to give her Pokémon some [[Poffin]]s when her {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}} charged towards her and ate all the Poffins but one, which {{TP|Dawn|Pachirisu}} later found.

However, before Pachirisu could pick up the Poffin from the ground, a {{TP|Ursula|Gabite}} belonging to a {{pkmn|Coordinator}} named [[Ursula]] appeared and stepped on the Poffin. This angered Pachirisu and led it to attack the {{pkmn|category|Cave Pokémon}} with {{m|Super Fang}}, surprising everyone. Ash then explained that learning a new [[move]] must have been the result of getting angry at Gabite. Seeing that, Ursula offered one of her own Poffins to calm Pachirisu down, but Pachirisu refused it, causing Ursula to take offense.

Ursula then took notice of [[Dawn's Piplup]] and remembered him from the [[Wallace Cup]]. She revealed that she was one of the contestants who had been eliminated in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]] and said that Dawn's victory was an accident and that she could not believe the [[Contest Judge]]s let someone like Dawn win. Before leaving, Ursula asked how many [[Ribbon]]s Dawn had and said she was looking forward to seeing her at the Chocovine Contest, adding that things would play out differently this time. This sparked a [[rival]]ry between the two.

===Poké Mart===
{{main|Poké Mart}}
The Chocovine Town Poké Mart was visited by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in ''[[DP113|Hold the Phione!]]''. It was where {{an|Dawn}} purchased new [[Seal]]s for {{cat|Dawn's Pokémon|her Pokémon}}, along with a few other items. [[Dawn's Piplup]] and {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}} were shown to have picked Heart Seals, while {{TP|Dawn|Pachirisu}} chose a Foamy Seal.

===Contest Hall===
{{main|Contest Hall}}
[[File:Chocovine Contest Top 8.png|thumb|left|220px|Battle Stage contestants]]
[[File:Chocovine Ribbon.png|thumb|220px|The Chocovine Ribbon]]
{{an|Dawn}}, [[Ursula]], and Jessilina competed against several other {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s in the Chocovine Contest in ''[[DP114|Another One Gabites the Dust!]]''.

During the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], Dawn used her {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}}'s {{m|Ice Beam}} to create a spiral {{wp|playground slide}} for Buneary to play on, impressing the [[Contest Judge|judges]] with how much fun the {{pkmn|category|Rabbit Pokémon}} seemed to be having. After that, Jessilina used her {{TP|Jessie|Yanmega}}'s {{m|Silver Wind}} coupled with the {{a|Speed Boost}} [[Ability]] to lift herself in the air while Ursula performed with a {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Burmy and Wormadam|Sandy Cloak}} {{p|Wormadam}} and commanded the worm of the desert to make a sculpture of itself out of a {{m|Sandstorm}} attack. When Marian appeared to [[Contest announcer|announce]] the results, it was revealed that the three of them were among the eight talented contestants moving on to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]].

There, [[Ursula's Gabite]] was shown defeating [[James's Carnivine|Jessilina's Carnivine]] before facing off against [[Dawn's Pachirisu]] in the finals. During their battle, Ursula tried her best to prove Dawn was not deserving of the {{DL|Ribbon|Aqua Ribbon}}. She took advantage of Gabite's {{stat|Speed}} and streamlined body, dodging most of Pachirisu's moves while simultaneously delivering successive attacks. However, Dawn eventually realized that an offensive approach was not the best way to deal with her opponent, and so she came up with several different ways of evading Gabite's attacks and seizing opportunities for Pachirisu to use its moves effectively, which led to Ursula losing a good amount of points. After a hard-fought battle, Dawn earned the coveted Chocovine Ribbon, her fourth {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]] overall.
